name: LG
title: The LG amino-acid exchangeability model
description:
Empirically derived amino-acid exchangeability matrix for general proteins.

LG supplies the symmetric exchangeabilities, not the equilibrium frequencies. When used as a complete substitution model, frequencies are estimated automatically; LG +> F makes this explicit. Use LG +> F(LG_freq) to fix frequencies to the values estimated in the paper.

citation.title: An Improved General Amino Acid Replacement Matrix
